title: Paxos pill button
description: Small fully-round pill buttons, 32–34px tall with 14px text: a solid slate fill with white text, or a hairline outline in the ink colour on a clear ground. The fill dims slightly and the outline fills faintly on hover, over 150ms.
notes: the bold variant is the heavier newsletter 'subscribe' button of the footer
name: paxos-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: slate fill · outline: a 1px ink ring on a clear ground · bold: taller, heavier solid (forms)

props.name: type
props.description: button type when it renders a button
